name: tracekit
description: Signed, tamper-evident evidence of what your coding agent did: every tool call checked by a policy before it runs, risky ones held for you, and each one recorded in a hash-chained, Ed25519-signed log that verifies offline.

interface.shortDescription: Every tool call checked, held for you when risky, and signed
interface.longDescription: Tracekit's hooks check each tool call before it runs: allowed, held until you approve it, or blocked. Every call and decision is signed into a record anyone can verify offline. Skills set it up and explain what it did.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Tracekit for this agent
